ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Initiating a class income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
